variants.label: Q1 read-only, 48 V lead-acid bank (24 cells)

notes: The owner confirmed five live Q1 readings; output voltage is line-to-line on this split-phase unit.

known_limitations: Q1 alone supplies no model identity or cell count. Battery voltage requires explicit selection of the 24-cell map.
No decoded flags, SOC, current, power, energy or controls. A Q1 response does not qualify the full 09C1 driver.
knowledge_summary: One FC4 Q1 read supplies AC input and output voltages, load percentage, reported AC frequency and temperature. Two owner LCD comparisons support pack voltage for the selected 48 V variant, without another request to the inverter.
